comments.author: @Playmotomoto
comments.text:
I visited my buddy who I have not seen in over 35 years. Flew into Seattle. Not a fan. Went north to Bellingham. Reminded me of Traverse City, Mi. My buddy lived in Glacier near Mount Baker. Very small community. Simply gorgeous landscapes. Had a accident on Mnt Baker. Ugh. Thats another story. 
The moss on the trees are 6 inches thick. Watch out for cougars/mountain lions.

replies.author: @Earthcue
replies.text: Oh my God, thank goodness everyone made it out alive. That was seriously dangerous. The fact that you still rushed in to help even though you got hurt yourself is incredible. So glad you all made it through safely. 🙏🙏🙏

replies.author: @Playmotomoto
replies.text: @EarthcueMy buddie and I were driving down from the ski resort. He had studs. The car with 4 ppl (one adult and 3 young kids) did not have studs or chains and went over the side and rolled. Pinned against the three small trees and a 600 foot drop below! I was the first to get to the car I fell inverted as I was grabbing broken tree roots into the windshield and unbeknownst to me I tore my bicep completely and my super spinatus tendon in the back shoulder! Long story short everybody survived including me. There was one young girl that had to have the jaws of life because her hand was crushed between the seat and car frame! I left licked my wounds with my buddy and we went to the bar at the bottom of Mount Baker to tell our tail! Three months later I was in the doctors office getting an MRI and four months after that I had surgery that four day trip with airfare food medical bills cost me $12,500  it made the news in Bellingham. I believe it was November 6, 2001
